## Safety / quality
- [ ] Native isometric geometry and STYLE.md unchanged unless approved
- [ ] All directional views / interactive states checked
- [ ] Pivot, shadow, alpha, and palette verified
- [ ] Existing approved sprites regenerated and diffed pixel-for-pixel
- [ ] New reusable primitives have tests
- [ ] No edits to live game without separate permission
